# fastf 3.20.1: the AUR build passes in every terminal

Building `fast-folder` from source runs fastf's test suite (`check()` in the
AUR package). In 3.20.0, one of those tests failed whenever the build ran in
Alacritty, WezTerm or Windows Terminal, and `paru fast-folder` stopped with
`A failure occurred in check()`. In kitty, Konsole or a terminal that names
itself only through `COLORTERM`, it passed.

fastf picks its colours from what the terminal announces, and those three
announce themselves through a variable of their own (Alacritty's window id,
WezTerm's pane). The test meant to read a terminal that announces nothing,
but it cleared only some of those variables. It now clears every variable
the colours are read from, and a new test fails, in any terminal, when one is
added without being listed. The suites' own copies of fastf are started
without them too, so they draw the same in every terminal as on a build
server.

fastf itself is unchanged from 3.20.0. Its release notes cover the folded
todo list and the refusal to move, rename or delete a folder something is
using.
